description: Defines a template class 'ScreenConnectorQueue' implementing a move-based concurrent queue with thread synchronization primitives, used for managing frame data in a screen connector context.

classes.name: ScreenConnectorQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe, move-only queue for managing items in a concurrent environment, with size control and synchronization features.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the queue in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: WaitEmpty
methods.description: Blocks until the queue becomes empty.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Adds an item to the queue, waiting if the queue is full.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the front item from the queue.
